summary.text: Jason Thoms is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A musician who founded the Bismarck nonprofit Dakota Pro Musica, he says his priorities are education, mental health care and ethical leadership.

paragraphs.text: Jason Thoms earned a bachelor's degree from St. Olaf College in 1996 and additional education from Michigan State University in 2005, and his career experience includes working as a musician.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he moved to Bismarck in the fall of 2020 and started Dakota Pro Musica, a nonprofit music and performing arts organization.
He said he has served as board president of the Capital Curling Club and of the Standing Committee of the Episcopal Church of North Dakota.
Thoms said he was endorsed as a candidate by the people of District 7 at the Dem-NPL Region 6 Convention on February 7, 2026, and he advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
He said he has spent his career in education and the arts, wants to make mental health care more accessible and affordable, and wants the 988 crisis line fully funded.
